Designed a linked component inventory module (stock tracking, reorder alerts, per-board usage traceability) on a Flasks

items.name: Integrated-Circuits-Inspection
items.description: Visual Inspection Automation is designed for image comparison tasks in electronics and manufacturing. Using computer vision techniques, it detects anomalies and assesses IC and PCB quality. The GUI leverages tkinter, while image processing utilizes OpenCV.

items.name: smarteye-ai-inspection
items.description: AI驱动PCB视觉质检系统。LangGraph 5-Agent协作编排 + YOLOv8 /OpenCV/SAM 2.1三引擎视觉检测 + ChromaDB RAG知识库 + Streamlit+FastAPI全栈架构。AI-powered PCB visual inspection with LangGraph 5-agent orchestration, YOLOv8+OpenCV+SAM 2.1 triple-vision engine, ChromaDB RAG knowledge base, and Streamlit+FastAPI full-stack architecture.

items.name: Automated-Visual-Quality-Control-Computer-Vision-
items.description: AI-powered visual inspection system for automated quality control using CNN + transfer learning. Classifies products as Pass/Defect in real time, with Grad-CAM highlighting defect regions. Optimized for >10 FPS and integrates with OpenCV. Applicable to PCB inspection, surface defects, and assembly line monitoring.

items.name: pcb-defect-detection-project-
items.description: Built an automated reference-free visual inspection system for smartphone PCBs using Python and OpenCV. It uses a pre-trained DenseNet-121 model to extract features and an SVM classifier with an RBF kernel to detect defects, localizing anomalies in 30 to 50 milliseconds per board.

items.name: visiq
items.description: VISIQ — full-stack AI visual inspection platform using Groq Vision AI + OpenCV to detect semiconductor defects (CPU, PCB, wafer) in real time with severity classification and sub-2s inference.
